phases.name: DISCOVERY
phases.goal: Inspect repo, services, Docker, database, environment, existing WhatsApp gateway, Hermes, n8n, Billing/RADIUS/GenieACS/MikroTik APIs.
phases.exit_gate: Architecture map document exists; existing APIs and capabilities inventoried; gap analysis produced.

phases.name: FOUNDATION
phases.goal: Build Case Engine, database schema, customer context, staff directory, audit log, state machine.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; case state machine enforced in code with tests; DB schema migration present.

phases.name: CONVERSATION AI
phases.goal: Build conversation state, intent detection, data collection, sufficiency engine, customer-safe response.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; conversation transitions to READY_FOR_DIAGNOSIS only when required data present; customer replies never leak internals.

phases.name: REASONING
phases.goal: Build structured case input, evidence collection, hypothesis engine, diagnostics, confidence, structured output.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; reasoning returns structured schema; unknown evidence stays UNKNOWN (no fabrication).

phases.name: TOOL GATEWAY
phases.goal: Integrate Billing, RADIUS, MikroTik, GenieACS — all behind permission/policy layer.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; every adapter behind deny-by-default registry; read-only staged adapters have contract tests.

phases.name: POLICY/RISK
phases.goal: Build allowlist, risk classification, approval, execution guard, verification.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; risk tiers enforced; approval binds exact action+parameters and expires.

phases.name: ESCALATION
phases.goal: Build NOC Senior escalation, Admin escalation, staff availability, priority, timeout, fallback.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; network→NOC Senior, non-network→Admin routing enforced; complete escalation context payload.

phases.name: INCIDENT CORRELATION
phases.goal: Build duplicate detection, mass incident correlation, common infrastructure correlation.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; correlated outage suppresses redundant diagnosis; mass incident grouping by topology/time.

phases.name: KNOWLEDGE/LEARNING
phases.goal: Build validated KB, resolution patterns, human corrections, feedback loop.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; learning cannot self-promote to production knowledge; human review gate exists.

phases.name: OBSERVABILITY
phases.goal: Build dashboard, metrics, audit, logs, health, alerts.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes; KPI/metrics endpoints present; audit trail complete; health endpoints respond.

phases.name: PRODUCTION HARDENING
phases.goal: Test duplicate messages, API failure, LLM timeout, tool timeout, network failure, WhatsApp reconnect, database failure, race conditions, repeated actions, unauthorized action, escalation failure, rollback.
phases.exit_gate: go test ./... passes including race; replay suite covers delayed/reordered/duplicate messages, dependency failure, gateway outage, concurrent cases.
